label: race-day tyre priors from history before each race, and the surprise (H3, D-058)
method: log life_raw per compound and log wear_multiplier = season level (random walk, shrunk toward the previous season) + track effect (recency-weighted, shrunk to 0), backfitted on the races strictly before each target (earlier seasons and earlier rounds); hyper-parameters chosen on 2000-2012 targets
caveats: truth = the race's own tyre-life fit (estimated_from_data, with its own estimation noise: the wear multiplier especially)
season-level calibration (kappa, wear curve shape, compound ratios) is fitted on the whole season and treated as known calibration, not race-day information
before 2018 the compounds are one measured stint length times 2018's ratios: no per-compound surprise
before 2010 life_raw (stint length) also carries the refuelling strategy
